note: Second dressing room through the doorway from the first. Feminine left (cat munching a shirt sleeve, sweating sewer worker by his manhole, girl jumping in her skirt, boy with cap and casket, sheep leaning on the wool basket, painter in a blue smock, shark in a striped scarf), masculine right (bee in a tiny outfit, scale heaped with cotton, tailor's crinkly crepe cloth with a pancake, spinning top in a vest top, man in a waistcoat with a jelly, giraffe in shorts, king in a tuxedo bowing (nobody smokes), golfer in a T-shirt). Left door back to the first dressing room; back door to the accessories room; right door to the grandparents' sitting room.
